heightM.note: the light towers' tops above the street, proportioned by eye

fenceLeftM.note: home plate to the left-field foul pole (335 ft)

fenceCentreM.note: home plate to the centre-field fence

fenceRightM.note: home plate to the right-field foul pole

basePathM.note: the 90 ft between bases (the rules of baseball)

moundM.note: home plate to the pitcher's plate, 60 ft 6 in (the rules of baseball)

centreFieldHeadingDeg.note: compass heading from home plate to centre field, by eye

homeOffsetM.note: how far home plate stands back from the landmark point (Wikidata P625), toward the stands

foulM.note: foul ground from the foul lines and behind home plate to the stands

lowerFrontM.note: the lower deck's front row above the field

lowerTopM.note: the lower deck's back row above the field

upperSetbackM.note: the upper deck's front row back from the lower deck's

upperFrontM.note: the upper deck's front above the field (the suites below it)

upperTopM.note: the upper deck's back row above the field

upperReachM.note: how far out along each foul line the upper deck runs

scoreboardWidthM.note: the scoreboard panel's width (a plain screen, no text)

scoreboardBaseM.note: the scoreboard panel's bottom above the street

readabilityScale.note: A generic ballpark (LEGAL-1: no logos, team names, sponsor marks or text; the scoreboard is a plain screen). Brick facade with stone trim.

gameScale.note: Game scale (orchestrator decision 2026-10-08, the user may overrule): heights x1.6 and plan x1.15, so the bowl reads at the 3,000-4,500 m game camera without its stands standing steeper than a real rake.
